text:
Verified 2026-10-01
env: conda-forge openfoam=2412, gmsh 4.15.2, pyvista 0.49.0, mpich 4.3.2 (wind-tunnel/env/environment.yml)
machines: shared qBraid gpu-l4 pool box (CPU queue, 2 MPI ranks; cgroup quota 5.1 CPUs) + subscription pod (serial lane)
Ahmed fine (1.37M cells): 1000 SIMPLE iterations ~53 min wall on 2 ranks; medium 35deg (0.59M): 14 min on 2 ranks
cylinder (35k cells, inlet 20D): t=0-120 in 17 min (linearUpwind) and 23 min (central) on 2 ranks
cost: $0 on-demand of its own; <= $0.80 share of the pool box ($0.49/h, 10 streams)
limits: Steady RANS (k-ω SST) with wall functions, no prism layers: the 25° slant flow stays attached, where the experiment separates and reattaches.
The model omits the stilts and uses a no-slip stationary floor; the reference drag is Ahmed et al. 1984 at 60 m/s (Re 4.3e6), these runs are at 40 m/s (Re 2.8e6).
Mesh ladder tops out at 1.37M cells (half model) on the lean budget; workshop-grade entries use 10-50M cells.
Cylinder frames and particles animate the real solver fields; the in-browser advection is a visual aid, not a solver.
